**Finding: deviation (Section 3.4 — Termination for Convenience)**

- **What works for us:** Customer may terminate the Agreement or individual Service Option Attachments for convenience on one month's notice, and IBM has no convenience right (Section 3.3 is breach-only). Section 3.4 also requires IBM to keep performing through the termination date. Notice period and mutuality therefore sit at the preferred position.
- **What fails:** Section 3.4(b) conditions the exit on early termination charges of unspecified size fixed in Attachment A and the Service Option Attachments, with no cap and no refund of prepaid fees (Section 3.5 only accelerates accrued amounts). An open-ended exit penalty fails the fallback, which allows an early-termination fee of no more than three months' fees.
- **Redline (validated, fallback level):** cap aggregate early termination charges at three months' charges for the terminated Services and require a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees; the favourable one-month notice period is left intact.
